card.title: Reality Is Coming Apart
card.instruction: Treat each contradiction, coincidence, and ordinary mistake as evidence that reality is losing structural integrity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your lift notice says 'third loor.' A letter's gone; the building's unravelling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my typo. I need the lift for deliveries.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me restore the F before you put any weight on that floor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's my marker. Oh, it's dried out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now matter's disappearing. Give me your delivery labels; I'll spell out every floor before we lose the stairs.

mechanism: A treats a missing printed letter and a dry marker as progressive losses in the building's reality, requiring restoration before delivery.
confusable: Unlike ordinary correction of a typo, A interprets small errors as evidence of structural failure in the world.
comparison: The building alternative moves from a missing letter to disappearing matter; the rent alternative moves from repeated speech to doubts about time continuing.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
